headline: Indian stock markets surge as foreign institutional inflows, lower oil prices, and Q2 earnings drive major rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong surge in foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows driving market optimism.
Declining crude oil prices providing a boost to market sentiment.
Positive Q2 earnings results fueling investor confidence.
Strong gains across financial and auto sector stocks leading the index rally.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,100 to 1,300 points while Nifty crossed above 25,300 levels.
Bajaj Finance announced a share sale aiming to raise up to $1.25 billion.
Indian stock market added approximately ₹35 lakh crore in market capitalization across seven sessions.
Gold prices dipped due to strong US inflation data bolstering dollar strength and Fed rate hike expectations.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices recorded substantial gains with the Sensex jumping over 1,000 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,300.
Strong foreign inflows, dropping crude oil prices, and upbeat Q2 earnings provided momentum across broader markets.
Key individual developments include Bajaj Finance planning a $1.25 billion capital raise alongside positive brokerage recommendations on select financial, auto, and defense stocks.
